people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
translations.bsb: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
translations.kjv: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
translations.asv: lest there be any fornication, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.
